m: व्य्-√ ऋ P. -ऋणोति, -ऋण्वति (3. pl. व्यृण्विरे; pf. व्य्-आर), to open (intr.), go apart or asunder, RV.; to open (trans.), spread abroad, display, ib.
व्य्-√ ऋछ् P. -ऋच्छति (only impf. व्यार्छत्), to go apart or asunder, ŚBr.

व्य्-√ ऋध् Pass. -ऋध्यते, to be unfortunate or unsuccessful, be excluded or deprived of (instr.), ŚBr. : Caus. -अर्धयति (Pass. -अर्ध्यते), to exclude from, deprive of (instr.), AitBr.; ŚBr. Desid. वीर्त्सति, to wish to nullify or render vain, AV. (cf. वीर्त्सा, p. 1007, col. 1).
व्य्-ऋद्ध mfn. unsuccessful, failed, miscarried, defective, imperfect, ŚBr.; Nir. (cf. अ-व्य्˚)
a: व्यृद्ध — p. p. 1 Deprived of prosperity, unlucky, unfortunate. --2 Deprived of or excluded from. --3 Nullified. --4 Imperfect, deficient.

m: व्य्-ऋद्ध—भाज् mfn. receiving a defective oblation as a share, ib.

v: strI virudDA fdDiH । virudDasampattO tatrArTe avyayo॰ । duryyavanam yavanAnAM virudDasampattO si॰ kO॰ ।
m: व्य्-ऋद्धि f. ill-luck, want of success, loss, failure, miscarriage, exclusion, VS.; AV.; Br.; Gaut.
want of prosperity, scarcity (of grain &c.), Pāṇ. ii, 1, 6.
a: व्यृद्धिः — f. Non-prosperity, ill-luck, misfortune (विगता ऋद्धिर्व्यृद्धिः); as in यवनानां व्यृद्धिर्दुर्यवनं Sk.

m: 1. व्य्-√ ऋष् P. -अर्षति, to flow through (acc.), RV.
2. व्य्-√ ऋष् P. -ऋषति, to pierce, penetrate, RV.
